_comment: How to find each catalog's winner on the event's English Wikipedia page. page: title pattern ({ord} = ordinal edition, {year} = event year); edition = year - edition_base. award: the award's own Wikipedia article (the page links to it). mode table = ceremony pages ({{Award category}} blocks, winner on the first bullet in bold); line = festival pages (film link nearest to the award link); section_bold = highlighted (bold) row inside a section. year_offset: catalog year = event year + offset. last_event_year: newest event already in the catalog (scripts/update.py advances it).
